entries.claim: The bounded browser smoke verifies the complete activity plan, monotonic reducer, result dedupe, token batching, reduced motion, responsive layout, and terminal cleanup.
The reducer accepts only monotonic stage transitions for the active turn.
Private progressive-search authority and body fields are rejected before rendering.
Provider token order is preserved while DOM writes are frame-batched.
A physical default-APK search displayed the complete ordered plan, live counters and current item, a streamed terminal answer, and an existing viewer citation.
entries.command: jq -e '.state == "pass" and .implementation_commit == "7464479a2228abcf90c4bc8fafe4a99b9a59ca30" and .search.complete_plan_observed_while_running and .search.live_counter_observed and .search.current_item_observed and .search.terminal_reason == "complete" and .search.citation_count_minimum >= 1' docs/evidence/artifacts/issue-644/live-search.json

entries.claim: Reduced motion and reader-controlled scrolling preserve the complete search result and restore follow mode only on explicit request.
A direct answer rendered no plan, while a real backup tool call rendered the closed display-only plan and reached PendingAction without changing confirmation authority.
